annotations.title: Today's product rows: deals of the day, trending, seasonal gift tips

description: The rows the website shows above the full product list (/produkty) for a buyer country, each a list of up to 12 products with the same summary fields as search_products: `deals` (today's price drops; discount against the offer's lowest price of the 30 days before the drop when 30 days of its history exist, else against the shop's own stated price; never an average), `trending` (trend = (1 + interest) × 0.5^(age_days / 14), interest = searches, product-page views and shop clicks of the last 30 days, age = days since the product entered the catalogue; 2+ shops only) and the seasonal rows of the buyer country's calendar (Black Friday, Christmas gifts by budget and for whom, Valentine's, Mother's Day, Father's Day, back to school, summer), e.g. `christmas:budget-500` or `christmas:for_her`. No product stands in two rows, one shop is behind at most 3 cards of a row, a row under 4 products is left out. `formulas` states every rule; `seasons` the active windows. `date` (YYYY-MM-DD) reads the calendar of another day with today's products. Next: get_product with a product slug for the full comparison.

date.description: The day the seasonal calendar is read for (default today).

deliver_to_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "CZ". Optional: normally derived from the address.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for human-readable strings, e.g. "en", "cs", "sk". Defaults to the country's default locale.
